messages:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU OOM spike on prod-serving-7 (model v2.1) — multiple containers restarted in 4m. Severity: P2. Investigation channel: #incidents/7401234567

sre-oncall: seeing repeated container restarts on gpu-pool-eu-west-1. Prefill path shows unusually long contexts. Anyone have quick confirmation on sequence lengths?

alice.dev: confirmed from tracing: several requests with full conversation history appended -> estimated seq lengths ~85k-120k tokens in last 10m, KV cache allocations blow past expected envelope.

ben.ml: pulling one container log now, truncated stack: 
```
2026-03-16T21:15:12Z ERROR runtime: CUDA OOM in gather_kv_cache (runtime/kernel.cu:421)
pid=2432 tid=1 signal=6
Alloc failed: 1.2GiB requested while 0.9GiB available
container restart triggered
```

maya-support: CS: flagged impacted customers acct-311 and acct-502, they've seen 502s and timeouts. Drafting a short customer message.

ryan-eng: quick mitigation: pushing a temporary prefill cap and routing fallback. Setting PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=65536 on routing for pool gpu-pool-eu-west-1, and routing >65k -> model-quant-lowmem. Applying now.

sre-oncall: executing: `kubectl set env deploy/serve-gpu PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=65536 -n prod` on 8 replicas. Patch rolled to 4/8, continuing.

alice.dev: also toggle KV cache trimming: `kv_cache_trim_threshold=0.78` on runtime config to evict stale prefixes earlier. Will push config update.

ben.ml: added a temporary dynamic fallback: if prefill tokens > 48k and GPU memory > 85% then route to cpu-prefetch-encode or quant variant. Deploying rule now.

incident-bot: Update: after PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS applied, restart rate decreased from 3.2/min -> 0.4/min across pool. Some residual restarts on older pods.

ryan-eng: telemetry shows OOM exceptions drop but tail latency for affected requests increased ~200-400ms due to fallback to quant variant. Need to balance availability vs quality.

maya-support: customer-facing note: "We detected GPU memory exhaustion for very long conversation histories. We've applied a temporary cap to long-context requests and a fallback model to keep service available. We're working on a permanent fix and will follow up." Sending now to impacted accounts.

sre-oncall: next steps: 1) keep PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=65536 until bench validated patch, 2) enable kv_cache_trim, 3) expand monitoring on per-tenant long-prefill rates and noisy-tenant isolation. I'm handing off to night-sre at 7401238000. Handoff notes in the watch doc.

alice.dev: long-term: implement streaming-prefill checkpointing (flush large prefixes to cold cache), and add a prompt-size quota at the API gateway with soft warnings. I'll open RFC and JIRA.

ben.ml: I'll create a reproducible synthetic test with 100k token prompt to validate kv trim and streaming changes. Posting bench link.

ryan-eng: added a temporary isolation route `noisy-tenant-shield` to divert suspected noisy tenants to dedicated nodes to avoid noisy neighbors.

maya-support: CS updated impacted customers with mitigation steps (shorten history, use embeddings for older context).

incident-bot: Status: mitigation in place, restarts reduced, customer impact limited to degraded latency and occasional failed requests. Incident P2 -> monitoring.
